title: Projected Grouped-Query Attention in PyTorch
prompt:
Implement a PyTorch grouped-query attention layer that shares key/value heads among query heads.

`GQA(n_heads, dim, n_kv_heads).forward(x, mask=None)` maps a floating `(B, T, dim)` tensor to the same shape. With `head_dim = dim // n_heads` and `kv_dim = n_kv_heads * head_dim`, expose biased linear layers `W_qkv: dim → dim + 2 * kv_dim` (all Q, then K, then V) and `W_o: dim → dim`.

Query head `h` uses KV head `h // (n_heads // n_kv_heads)`. Use scaled dot-product attention; support one KV head, intermediate counts, and equal query/KV head counts.

The optional boolean mask broadcasts to `(B, n_heads, T, T)`; True permits attention. Every query has an allowed key, and causality is caller-controlled. Assert positive constructor values, `dim % n_heads == 0`, and `n_heads % n_kv_heads == 0`. Assume other shapes are compatible. Preserve dtype, device, and autograd without mutation. Use CPU PyTorch; no other transformer components are required.

example.reasoning: Query heads 0 and 1 share KV head 0, while query heads 2 and 3 share KV head 1. Projection widths are 8 for Q and 4 each for K and V.
